A '''direct cranial uplink''' was a feature of the [[3D-4X administrative droid]]. Three uplinks were installed on the back of the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] cranial unit.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
